args.name: Assess an unfamiliar food sample safely
args.function: Investigate an owned hazelnut sample using feasible non-ingestive observation or trials, to establish whatever evidence is obtainable about edibility, processing requirements, and nutritional usefulness while explicitly retaining unresolved uncertainty.
args.conditions: I have observed a mature hazelnut plant near (15.4,14.5), with five units visible at tick 15. Its nutrition, toxicity, and processing requirements are unknown to me. I intend to collect two units. Berries are my known-safe alternative.
args.inputs: An actually owned hazelnut sample, if collection succeeds; any other necessary tools or materials must be specified and acquired.
args.costs: Method, time, energy, materials, and learning requirements are unknown; determine a feasible limited procedure.
args.effects: Produce only findings supported by actual examination or trials. Do not guarantee safety from appearance, confer mastery through this request, or require ingestion of an unassessed sample.

candidates.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

candidates.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; cancel unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1; one plot per unit) gathered from a living plant; stock still on a plant is not owned. x, y: a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Three paid rounds of 1 energy: loosen, place, cover; plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect and inspect-progress: one round, 0.2 energy. Inspect: inputStackId checks a unit (with x, y also a site for it), or target a plant source or plot in reach. Inspect-progress: target a plot in reach. Maintain: refused at no cost. Cancel: one round, no energy. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is given.
candidates.effects: Loosening keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Placing moves it, with origin and age, into the open plot, where it cannot be eaten or used. Covering completes planting, not establishment: the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one, rooting only through actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season; cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On rooting, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock (ceiling 4), regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone with gather; a ledger records growth and units produced and removed. Nothing is copied or guaranteed. A unit check reports decay, treatment, origin and whether it can be planted, never viability. Inspect-progress reports visible changes since your last look, else inconclusive; trial window 120 rounds, checks every 10; not a growth date. Maintain: no water transfer, amendment or hand-changeable obstruction exists. Records are unverified. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Cancel, or death, before placing returns the unit once (where the person died); after placing, the unit stays uncovered, does not root and ages. No reward or refund.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"reuse\",\"ability\":\"probe\",\"reason\":\"The existing probe operation directly covers feasible non-ingestive examination and small physical trials of an owned sample. Its observe, press, wet and heat arguments already provide general assessment modes; a new food-assessment capability would duplicate that function. The related-capability search and retrieved probe contract support reuse. The requested outcome explicitly permits unresolved uncertainty, so an observation yielding no evidence about safety or nutrition is a valid limited result, not grounds to invent an assay. Collection has already succeeded: the supplied ownership record contains two hazelnut units.\",\"specification\":\"Reuse probe, equivalence open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1; do not register a replacement or claim reinvention. Use its existing schema: target string (maximum 360 characters), mode observe|press|wet|heat, intensity number from 0 to 1, with no additional parameters. First executable action: target=item-19-lin-197, mode=observe, intensity=0, provided the actual owned stack is visible and within the handler's physical interaction range. Recheck ownership, accessibility, remaining quantity and condition at execution; ownership alone does not establish reach. The stack was harvested at tick 19 from start-1-nuts and contains two units; the old tick-15 observation is not a current stock measurement. Observation requires no additional supplied tool or consumable, takes one round and costs 0.2 energy. Report only externally observable features actually supported by the simulation, explicitly recording unavailable or inconclusive observations. No tasting or ingestion is part of this procedure. A later physical trial is a separate probe invocation costing one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 unit from the actual selected sample. Choose a mode only when its real physical prerequisites and supported effect are present: no water, heat source, tool, analytical instrument or external reference is granted. In particular, wet and heat cannot create their required material or energy source. Press may be attempted only to the extent actual manual force and the existing handler support it; a resistant shell is an informative limitation, not automatic access to a kernel. Record any consumed sample allocation and any real transformed material or residue without duplication; retained stock continues ageing, and no edible product or treatment is credited unless actually produced. Use only the existing handler's measurable effects; this reuse adds no cracking, cooking, toxicity assay or nutrient assay mechanism. Compare observations with lin's retained knowledge, distinguishing the personal berry record from evidence about this sample. Appearance, resemblance, pressing response or absence of visible spoilage cannot establish edibility, absence of toxins, nutritional value or a required processing recipe. Keep all unsupported properties unknown. Each action is the existing one-round interaction, with interruption=cancel and no resumable partial mastery or trial progress; another attempt is a new paid interaction. Apply the existing handler's transaction rules to interruption, cancellation or death: never award completion for an unfinished interaction, never duplicate inputs, and never refund costs already spent. Unspent or unconsumed owned material remains subject to ordinary inventory and death rules. There is no continuing assessment process, maintenance obligation or automatic future testing. Development/review waiting advances no time. Findings require actual observations, not this review.\",\"learning\":0,\"experienceReview\":\"Reuse grants no learning, mastery, pleasure, satisfaction or nutrition. Any benefit must use established executable reward rules with functional deduplication, a bounded amount and cap, decay and cooldown; absent such an applicable rule, award none rather than invent a reward. Legitimate repeated practice may support only an already-defined modest maintenance benefit. No reward account, budget, goal or permission changes; no mood-based reduction of basic nutrition and no physical-comfort benefit from this assessment.\",\"visualReview\":\"Reuse the existing probe interaction visuals and observable events. Findings may be labelled observed, inconclusive or unresolved; do not show safe-food, cooked, detoxified, nutritious or successful-shell-opening imagery unless that specific real effect is established. An interrupted or failed attempt may display its actual attempt or failure, never a success marker. No new catalogue interface or visual event is presumed to exist merely because this review approved reuse.\"}]}"}
